title: SII Vol. 9 No. 701 — Kunthuru
location_detail: On A Slab Set Up To The East Of The Basavesvara Temple At Kunthuru, Kollegal Taluk, Coimbatore District
summary: This record is dated Saka 1434, Angirasa, Jyeshtha, su. 15, corresponding to A.D. 1512 May 30, Sunday (not verifiable), in the reign of the Ummattur chief, Immadi-Chikkaraya-Odeya, son of Mahavira-Nanjaraya-Odeya, who is stated to have made a sarvamanya gift of the village Kunturu to the Salur-Santa
